AI can improve job satisfaction by automating routine tasks, allowing employees to focus on more meaningful work [3][4]. Conversely, negative perceptions of AI, especially regarding fairness and job security, can lead to increased stress, disengagement, and turnover intentions [2][6]. The lack of transparency in AI systems can exacerbate feelings of paranoia and anxiety, significantly impacting mental well-being [3][4][5].

## The Role of Transparency and Communication
Transparency in AI systems is critical for fostering trust and positive employee attitudes [1][7]. When employees are informed about how AI systems make decisions, they tend to have more positive views of those decisions [4][5]. Organizations that prioritize clear communication, employee involvement, and ethical AI practices can mitigate negative impacts and enhance positive outcomes [1][7][8].
